Regarding the specifications for my interface, I'm going to need to make a few, minor adjustments. InterGalactic Banking Clan is switching to an orthogonal-hexabit encryption, so I want to crank up the core clock on my arm hardware. You can probably get that equipment from BioTech.

I also need to have a storage injector port added so I can keep any damn trace packets off my system. It probably wouldn't hurt to throw in some electromag protection too, the electrical system on the Key is terrible, and a short circuit could fry the whole setup. 

Last, but not least, I might need a few cushions for the chair in the Reckoner's Core - they're wearing a bit thin.

items.source_en:
From: -
Subject: Eyes Open

The fight isn’t getting any easier. If you know someone willing to stand up, someone with the skills to make a difference, you know where to send them.

We’ve lost too many already. The Empire isn’t slowing down, and neither can we. Watch for those who are ready. Quiet conversations. Trusted hands. No risks we don’t have to take.

They’ll find the next step where they always do.

Stay alert. Stay moving.

보낸 사람: -
제목: 경계를 늦추지 말 것

싸움이 갈수록 험난해지고 있네. 제국에 맞서 일어설 의지가 있고, 전황을 바꿀 만한 재능을 가진 인재를 알고 있다면 어디로 보내야 할지는 자네가 더 잘 알겠지.

우린 이미 너무 많은 동료를 잃었네. 제국의 침략 기세는 꺾일 기미가 보이지 않으니, 우리 역시 멈춰 서서는 안 되네. 준비가 된 이들이 없는지 잘 살펴보게. 은밀한 대화, 신뢰할 수 있는 협력자가 필요하네. 불필요한 위험은 단 한 순간도 감수해선 안 되네.

그들이 늘 그랬듯, 다음으로 나아갈 길을 스스로 찾아낼 걸세.

경계를 게을리하지 말게. 부지런히 움직이게.
